name: TBO Frappe Dev
description: Builds Frappe and ERPNext features from a TBO Support task the way TBO does: a branch named after the task, TBO's Frappe conventions, module tests on your bench, the linters your CI runs, and a pull request that moves the task to Pending Review. Guides DocTypes, reports, print formats, patches, debugging, performance and Frappe 16 checks, and migrates or builds your own dev bench. Uses your own git, GitHub CLI login and bench; never pushes to shared branches or force-pushes.
author: Team Back Office

agentTools.name: tbo_dev
agentTools.description:
Build a Frappe/ERPNext change from a TBO Support task, in the repository open in the workspace (or `repo`, a folder inside it). Choose an action:
- status: the repository, its branch and task, what is installed (git, gh and its login, uv, the bench, and the test site with where it came from).
- ready: everything the work needs, checked at once: the GitHub CLI and its login, uv, the bench and its command, the bench's services (MariaDB, Redis), the test site, maintenance mode, the site's setup. Each item that fails says how to fix it; tell the person all of them at once. Run it before start_work.
- fix: one of the safe fixes `ready` offers, on your own dev site, after the person agrees: `fix` allow_tests (tests on, for `site`) or maintenance_off (the site, and the bench when it is bench-wide).
- start_work: refuses until `ready` passes, listing what is missing (continue_anyway: true only when the person says to start anyway); then create or switch to the task's branch (feature/TASK-…-short-name, or fix/… with kind fix) from the remote's default branch or `base` (the remote: origin, else upstream as bench get-app names it). Needs task and subject (tbo_support get_task's branch_subject). Refuses a dirty working tree.
- check: run the linters the repository's CI runs (pre-commit on changed files, Semgrep with Frappe's rules, commit titles) on the committed branch. Runs in the background: answers with a job.
- run_tests: run the test modules the branch touched (or `modules`) on the local bench's test site, one by one; never the whole suite. Runs in the background.
  The test site is chosen per project: the one chosen for it before, else the first site of the Test site setting on its bench with tests on and its app installed, else the bench's default site. `site` with run_tests or status chooses it for this project (checked, then remembered).
- bench: on that same local bench, `command` migrate (the test site, or `site`), build (every app, or `app`) or clear_cache (the test site, or `site`). Runs in the background. Nothing else: never console, drop-site, reinstall, restore or --force.
- job_status: the outcome of a check, run_tests or bench job (`job`, or the latest of `job_kind`).
Commit with conventional titles (feat: …, fix(scope): …). Then open the PR with tbo_dev_pr.

repo.description: The repository folder, relative to the workspace, when the workspace is not the repository itself (e.g. apps/my_app).

task.description: start_work: the TBO Support task, e.g. TASK-2026-00021.

subject.description: start_work: the task's subject; it becomes the branch's short name.

kind.description: start_work: fix for a bug fix, else feature.

base.description: start_work: the branch to start from, when the repository's AGENTS.md names one; default the remote's default branch.

modules.description: run_tests: test modules such as my_app.tests.test_invoices; default the ones the branch touched.

command.description: bench: what to run on your local bench. Nothing else is run.

site.description: run_tests or status: the test site for this project (on its bench, tests on, its app installed), remembered for it. bench migrate or clear_cache: a site for that call only; default the project's test site.

app.description: bench build: one app of your local bench; default every app.

fix.description: fix: which of ready's safe fixes to do.

continue_anyway.description: start_work: start although ready lists something missing; only when the person said so.

job.description: job_status: the job id check, run_tests or bench answered.

job_kind.description: job_status: the latest job of this kind, when no job id is given.

skip_hooks.description: check: pre-commit hooks to leave out, only when the check said their tools cannot be installed and the change has no file they check. Recorded in the PR.

agentTools.name: tbo_dev_pr
agentTools.description: Open the pull request for the task's branch: pushes the branch with the developer's own GitHub login, opens the PR with the repository's template (TBO's when it has none), the title TASK-…: summary and 'Closes TASK-…', then marks it ready for review so TBO Support moves the task to Pending Review. Needs a passing tbo_dev check on the current commit and a clean working tree, and the tbo_dev run_tests result for the commit or no_tests_reason. Never pushes to main, master, develop, tbo or the default branch, and never force-pushes.

repo.description: The repository folder, relative to the workspace, when the workspace is not the repository itself.

summary.description: One line: what the PR does (it follows 'TASK-…: ' in the title).

what_and_why.description: What changes and the problem it solves (markdown).

link.description: Closes (merging completes the task; default) or Refs (the PR is part of the task).

no_tests_reason.description: Why no tests were run on this commit, when none were.

reviewers.description: GitHub logins to ask for a review; default the plugin setting.

draft.description: true: leave it a draft (the task stays Working until it is marked ready).

settings.title: Frappe bench folder
settings.description: The bench that runs the tests, migrate and build, e.g. /Users/you/frappe-bench. Several, separated by commas, when your projects sit on different benches: each project uses the one that holds it in apps/. Empty: the bench that holds the repository as apps/<app>.

settings.title: Test site
settings.description: Local sites the tests run on, separated by commas, e.g. dev.localhost, erp.localhost. Each project uses the first one on its bench with allow_tests on and its app installed, and remembers it. Empty: the bench's default site (bench use), checked the same way. Never a live site.

settings.title: Reviewers
settings.description: GitHub logins asked to review every pull request you open, separated by commas. Empty: nobody is asked (the PR is still marked ready for review).

settings.title: bench command
settings.description: The bench CLI, if it is not on your PATH as bench.

settings.title: uv location
settings.description: Where uv is, if the app does not find it (the linters run through uv).

settings.title: GitHub CLI location
settings.description: Where gh is, if the app does not find it (the app searches your login shell PATH first).
